findings.claim: Contractless mode generates a string-key map formatter for the data type but sets ObjectSerializationInfo.Create with resolverOptions and no explicit MessagePackSecurity handling; additionally, members are deserialized via generated code using the formatter resolver for arbitrary member types, so nested depth is only limited if generated template calls options.Security.DepthStep. This is presumably the existing template behavior; no new bypass is evident. However, the user-declared formatter is a public partial class that also gets generated with IsUserDeclaredFormatter, and its generated code is not checked to emit DepthStep for class types with zero members.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a generator snapshot test with [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] on a partial class for a nested type and verify generated Deserialize calls options.Security.DepthStep(ref reader) and reader.Depth--, as other formatters do.
